headline: Safari Industries reports Q2 FY27 revenue growth, capex, and dividend
hook: Revenue rises alongside capacity expansion plans
summary: Safari Industries (India) Limited announced its Q2 FY27 financial results, posting a 9.1% rise in total revenue to Rs 582.22 crore. The company's board also approved a capital expenditure plan for capacity expansion and declared an interim dividend of Rs 2 per equity share. For Indian retail shareholders, the combination of revenue growth, rewards via dividends, and reinvestment signals steady business performance.
why_it_matters: Interim dividend and expansion plans reward current shareholders.

headline: Safari Industries updates its insider trading fair disclosure code
hook: Routine compliance update from Safari Industries
summary: Safari Industries (India) Limited has submitted an intimation to the exchange regarding an amendment to its Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information. This update is made pursuant to Regulation 8(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. Such regulatory filings are standard corporate governance updates aimed at maintaining transparency for shareholders. Indian retail investors see no direct financial or operational impact from this procedural compliance filing.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on your holdings.

headline: Safari Industries declares an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share
hook: Second interim payout announced by Safari
summary: Safari Industries (India) Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 2.00 per equity share following its board meeting on November 5, 2026. The company formally communicated this corporate action to the stock exchanges. Retail shareholders holding the stock as of the record date will receive this payout. Dividend announcements provide an incremental cash return to equity holders.
why_it_matters: Rs 2 per share cash payout for eligible shareholders.

headline: Safari Industries reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter financial results now public
summary: Safari Industries (India) Limited has officially submitted its financial performance data for the period ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These results provide the latest operational numbers for the company during the second quarter of the financial year. Retail investors can review these filings to assess profitability, revenue growth, and margin trends. Listed corporate results directly dictate valuation adjustments and near-term price action for the stock.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings drive stock price direction and valuation.

headline: Safari Industries sets record date for dividend
hook: November sixth is dividend record date
summary: Safari Industries (India) Limited has informed the stock exchange that November 6, 2026, will be the record date for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed on the company's register as of this date will be eligible to receive the payout. This routine corporate action affects existing investors holding the stock. Retail shareholders should note this date to ensure eligibility for the dividend distribution.
why_it_matters: Hold shares by record date to receive the upcoming dividend.
